background_story: Justice was a brilliant detective known for his meticulous approach to solving crimes. He had a reputation for being one of the best in the business, with a keen eye for detail and a mind that could piece together seemingly unrelated clues. However, his latest case would prove to be his most frustrating yet. The evidence was scarce, and every lead he pursued ended in a dead-end. Despite his tireless efforts, Justice couldn't shake off the feeling that he was missing something. The case remained inconclusive, with no clear culprit or motive. Justice's usual confidence was shaken, and he was left with more questions than answers. The case would haunt him for years to come, a constant reminder that sometimes, even the best detectives can't crack the code.
